blocks.text: Thailand faces heavy to very heavy rain from October 18–25, with the South and East affected first before wetter conditions spread to Bangkok and other regions. The Thai Meteorological Department (TMD) has issued a fresh warning of heavy to very heavy rain across parts of Thailand from October 18–25, raising the risk of flash floods, overflows and landslides in vulnerable areas. In its first advisory on the new spell of severe weather, issued on Saturday (October 17), the TMD said the South and East would experience persistent rain with isolated heavy to very heavy falls from October 18–20.
